note: 本候选对应的桥接句是 2026-10-12 合并后的一句（原文两条候选——electrician-salary 与 how-to-become-a-cna——已被本仓库 prose-gate 批次合成同一句），故此处把此前两条已核记录合并为一条，逐项核对目标文章 how-to-become-a-cna 原文：(1)'much shorter training bar' —— 目标页称联邦对护士助理培训设 75 小时下限，'well short of the multi-month or multi-year programs required for most other healthcare roles'，成立；(2)'state-approved program with a federal floor of 75 hours under 42 CFR 483.152' —— 目标页原文即 '42 CFR § 483.152: a state-approved program must run at least 75 clock hours'，逐字对应；(3)'BLS puts the nursing assistant median at $42,260' —— 目标页正文与 FAQ#3 均为 May 2025 中位 $42,260，成立；(4)'well below both firefighters and electricians' —— 本站 BLS 数据 33-2011 消防员中位 $59,280、47-2111 电工中位 $63,190（electrician-salary 页原文亦为 'The median annual wage for electricians was $63,190 in May 2025'），均高于护士助理 $42,260，成立。
sentence: [CNAs](/how-to-become-a-cna/), by contrast, need a much shorter training bar, a state-approved program with a federal floor of 75 hours under 42 CFR § 483.152, and BLS puts the nursing assistant median at $42,260, well below both firefighters and electricians.
